This page is drawn from crates/vike-ui-theme/ui-theme.toml, the one file that holds every design value of the desktop GUI. It is regenerated by a test, so it cannot disagree with the app. The switches above change the theme, the text size and the density of the whole page the way the Appearance settings change the app.

Status colours

The same in every theme. A theme recolours the background, the neutrals and the accent, and never recolours "connected".

ok #3fbf6e

A healthy state — a live link, a configured credential, a saved write.

warning #e6b428

Not settled yet — a link dialling or reconnecting, an armed remote-control segment, an account named but not yet saved, a store nobody could open.

error #f0524a

A fault — a failed link, a refused write, an inline error.

info #57a5ff

Information — egui's hyperlink colour.

muted #787878

Nothing live to show — Disconnected and Unknown alike (only a label tells them apart), an unset credential. Grey 120 is a MARK's colour and sits below the 4.5:1 floor for text.

Account modes

Where an account trades. Each part of a mode's chip is named by a colour ROLE, never by a hex, so changing the colour a mode wears is one line of [[mode]] in ui-theme.toml. The chip and the venue chip's mark are drawn here from the rows the app reads, on each theme's own background.

The roles: accent border text text2 text3 bg surface card hover text_ui grad_top analysis_line up down up_text down_text ok warning error info muted on_fill none. A role is read against the theme the trader chose, so one row is a different colour on each theme below; a status role is the same on all four.

Maps

Which colour, word or icon each state or kind of a mapping uses: a connection's state, a button's kind, a calendar event's importance. One row per state in [[map]] of ui-theme.toml, grouped by the mapping it belongs to, and the code binds each of its variants to a row. A colour is a ROLE, shown here as a swatch in Graphite; an icon is a key of the icon registry, shown as its glyph.

Button

KeyColourFillStrokeTextWordIconCountFlagWhat it is
PRIMARY—accent—on_fill————The one action a view exists for (Save, Apply, Run; the strip's Place): the fill in the theme's accent, no outline, the label in the on-fill black; under the pointer the fill is lifted in code a step toward the text colour.
SECONDARYhoversurfacebordertext_ui————Everything else (Refresh, Cancel), and the Trade window's plain button: the surface fill, an outline in the border grey, the label in the UI text; under the pointer the fill is the theme's hover fill.
BUY—up—on_fill————Buy, also the Trade window's tall Buy: the fill in the market set's up colour, no outline, the label in the on-fill black; under the pointer the fill is lifted in code a step toward the text colour.
SELL—down—on_fill————Sell, also the Trade window's tall Sell: the fill in the market set's down colour, no outline, the label in the on-fill black; under the pointer the fill is lifted in code a step toward the text colour.
DANGER—error—on_fill————An action that destroys something (Delete): the fill in the status red, no outline, the label in the on-fill black; under the pointer the fill is lifted in code a step toward the text colour.
CHOSEN—cardaccenttext————The Trade window's chosen button (a chosen order type, Reduce only while on, the one-click padlock while one-click is on): the card fill ringed in the theme's accent, the label in the full text colour; it does not change under the pointer.

KeyColourFillStrokeTextWordIconCountFlagWhat it is

Side

KeyColourFillStrokeTextWordIconCountFlagWhat it is
BUYup——up_text————A buy: an order or a print on the buying side (a resting buy's marker and pill, a print's bubble, the side word of a working order): the graphic in the market's up, the word in its up text.
SELLdown——down_text————A sell: an order or a print on the selling side (a resting sell's marker and pill, a print's bubble, the side word of a working order): the graphic in the market's down, the word in its down text.

SHORTdown——down_text————A short position: the Trade ticket's SHORT word, a backtest trade's short side, the options chain's badge for a net short position: the word and the badge in the market's down.
BIDup——up_text————The bid side of a book: a bid's depth size, the bid bar and the inside-bid wash on a ladder, the Bid button, the bid step line, an options chain's bid cells and their hover wash: the graphic in the market's up, the numbers in its up text.
ASKdown——down_text————The ask side of a book: an ask's depth size, the ask bar and the inside-ask wash on a ladder, the Ask button, the ask step line, an options chain's ask cells and their hover wash: the graphic in the market's down, the numbers in its down text.
GAINup——up_text————Money made: a P&L, a realized, unrealized or funding figure, a trade's profit, a curve that ends above where it began: the number in the market's up text, the curve in its up.
LOSSdown——down_text————Money lost: a P&L, a realized, unrealized or funding figure, a trade's loss, a drawdown, a curve that ends below where it began: the number in the market's down text, the curve in its down.
POSITIVEup——up_text————A number above zero that is not money (a Greek, a tearsheet metric, a Sharpe, the move off the price to beat, an earnings surprise): the number in the market's up text.
NEGATIVEdown——down_text————A number below zero that is not money (a Greek, a tearsheet metric, a Sharpe, the move off the price to beat, an earnings surprise): the number in the market's down text.
TAKE_PROFITup——up_text————A take-profit exit: the ladder's T marker and the ticket's TP words: the marker in the market's up, the words in its up text.
STOP_LOSSdown——down_text————A stop-loss exit: the ladder's S marker and the ticket's SL words: the marker in the market's down, the words in its down text.
RISEup——up_text————A rising candle as the chart-style icons draw their examples: the candle in the market's up.
FALLdown——down_text————A falling candle as the chart-style icons draw their examples: the candle in the market's down.
ABOVE_FORECASTup——up_text————A released figure above its forecast, in the Calendar's Actual column: the figure in the market's up text.
BELOW_FORECASTdown——down_text————A released figure below its forecast, in the Calendar's Actual column: the figure in the market's down text.
OUTCOME_UPup——up_text————The Up outcome of a Polymarket up/down market (its odds on the chain cards and in the header, its payout preview on the ticket): the words in the market's up text.
OUTCOME_DOWNdown——down_text————The Down outcome of a Polymarket up/down market (its odds on the chain cards and in the header, its payout preview on the ticket): the words in the market's down text.

Rules of use

A value says what; a rule says where.

  • Words are Inter. A venue name, an account NAME (main), a label, a button, a menu item.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • Anything read character by character is JetBrains Mono: prices, sizes, counts, addresses, account NUMBERS (3709890).Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • Menu items, buttons and tabs are the Strong role at regular weight (400). Semibold (600) is ruled only where the design draws it — the places listed under weight_use below — and is never a venue or a label.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller, crates/vike-ops/tests/gui/ui_literal_ratchet.rs::no_file_gains_a_heavy_weight
  • Two things on one line (a venue and its account) are told apart by size and ink — the primary ink for the first, the dim ink and the Body size for the second — not by weight.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • The accent is a shape (an underline, a fill, a ring, an edge), never the colour of a number or a word.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/input.rs::selected_text_is_never_drawn_in_the_accent
  • The status colours are the same in every theme. "Connected" is the status green, never the accent.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/mod.rs::status_colours_are_fixed_and_never_the_accent, crates/vike-ui-theme/src/status.rs::no_status_colour_is_a_theme_or_market_colour
  • Every window has the same 25 pt title bar at every density. Density scales the controls inside a window, never the bar around it.Words only — no test fails if this is broken.
  • A size is a ROLE. A literal font size anywhere in a GUI crate fails a gate: the Text size setting must reach every window.Enforced by crates/vike-ops/tests/gui/ui_literal_ratchet.rs::no_file_gains_a_literal_text_size

Spacing, strokes and strengths

The steps the kit and the windows draw with. A gap, a line or a mix is a name, not a number typed at the call site.

Spacing

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
NONE0pxNo gap: rows, cells and bars that must touch (a table whose row height IS its pitch, columns that land on computed widths).
HAIR1pxOne point: two lines of text in one cell, a badge's top and bottom padding.
XS2pxThe finest step: the padding an icon button leaves round its glyph, and how far the focus ring stands off its widget.
SM4pxA small gap and the vertical padding of a button; the most-used step.
MD6pxA medium gap; Normal density's gap between controls.
LG8pxA large gap; Normal density's cell padding.
XL12pxA section gap: the largest step the windows used before the scale grew.
XL216pxA block gap: between a window's sections, and the inset of a framed region.
XL324pxThe widest gap: the breathing room above a screen's first block.

Strokes

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
HAIRLINE1pxA control's edge, a card's border, a rule: every kit widget draws its outline at this width.
LINE1.5pxA mark that must read at a glance, such as the venue chip's ring.
EDGE2pxThe selected edge: the underline of the chosen tab.

Strengths

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
LIFT0.12How far a filled button moves toward the text colour while it is hovered or pressed.
WASH0.14How far a chip's fill is mixed into the ground behind it (Mode::wash): enough to read as a coloured band on every theme's near-black background, and little enough that what is written on it still reads. On LIVE's accent wash the least of the three inks is the accent itself as text on Dusk, 5.58:1; the theme text clears 12.21:1 and the warning amber 7.53:1 on every theme, Carbon's amber wash included (8.25:1).

The mark

The Vike mark and its orange are drawn from crates/vike-ui-theme/src/brand.rs; the files are in this folder (see SOURCES.md). The orange is the logo's colour and never a UI accent.

orange #ff6a00

The brand orange, vike.io's --color-brand. The site's PNG is painted #FF751F; that one is not used (refinement 2).

orange-on-light #d95400

The orange on a LIGHT background: ORANGE on white is under the 3:1 a graphic needs (refinement 4).

Generated — do not edit. Change ui-theme.toml, run VIKE_REGEN_BRAND_ASSETS=1 cargo test -p vike-ui-theme --test brand_assets, and look at this page.
